name: 🥩 Steakhouse Steak & Fries
what: A hard-seared steak with garlic butter and crispy oven fries.
early: 30 min before: steak out of the fridge, patted dry and salted. Turn the fan on, it'll smoke.

core.name: Frozen fries
core.out: potato puffs or sweet potato fries

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to the temperature on the fries bag.
Spread the fries in one layer and bake, flipping once.
With 12 minutes left: heat a cast-iron pan on high until smoking. Oil, then the steak. Don't touch it.
Flip. Add butter and garlic and spoon the foaming butter over the steak.
Rest the steak 8 minutes, then slice thin across the grain.

key: Dry steak, smoking-hot pan, don't move it. Then let it rest.
plan_b: No cast iron or too smoky? Broil the steak 5 minutes a side.
